title: How a Godly Man Runs His Own Race When Everyone Else Seems to Be Winning
caption:
The engagement post. The new job. The house. You know the feeling before you've even finished scrolling past it.

Here's what nobody tells you in that moment: you're watching his finish line, not his 3 a.m. Comparison always lies about the middle.

Scripture doesn't tell you to run his race. It tells you to run the one marked out for you. Different calling, different pace, different finish line entirely.

Let his win be proof God moves, not evidence you've been forgotten.

#faith #godlyman #comparison #contentment #scripture
